collection.title: Volvo C30 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Volvo C30 2006 to 2009 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this C30 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
